verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows law-firm or outside-counsel roles, or any invited counsel access for preparing documents and updating records. Board consent generation, conversion recording, and e-signature are documented, but only for company administrators. The Excel pro forma meant for the legal team is an export, not counsel working in the platform. Third-party permissioning is a fair question for an equity-management platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".
